description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the co-occurrence number and accuracy (ACC) percentage for various models. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to 10^3, and tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot displays six lines representing different models: Base (black, circle marker, solid line), FT (blue, triangle marker, solid line), IKE (red, triangle marker, solid line), MEND (brown, diamond marker, solid line), MEMIT (purple, diamond marker, solid line), and ROME (green, square marker, solid line). The Base line starts at around 63% at a co-occurrence number of 3 and increases to approximately 70% at 10^3. The FT line begins at around 64% and rises to about 73% at 10^3. The IKE line starts at roughly 66% and reaches around 75% at 10^3. The MEND line begins at approximately 70% and increases to about 81% at 10^3. The MEMIT line starts at around 69% and rises to approximately 79% at 10^3. The ROME line begins at roughly 74% and reaches around 86% at 2*10^3. All lines exhibit a generally increasing trend as the co-occurrence number increases.
